title: Tic-tac at 31 times the speed of sound with no sonic signature

tellings.quote: so when an object can travel at greater than five times the speed of sound like the tic-tac which is estimated to reach at least 31 times the speed of sound and it doesn't disturb the air around you

plain: The Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint and reported by Navy pilots, is said to have reached at least 31 times the speed of sound without disturbing the air around it. A young researcher named Deep Prasad makes the point on Michels' show, summarising it without naming where the estimate comes from, in a discussion he connects to the researcher Eric Weinstein. If true, it would mean something moving far past any known aircraft without making the shock waves fast objects normally create.
